data.title: My Husband Lost His Job and Owes $624K From Bitcoin Mining. Should We Sacrifice Our Home to Pay It Off?
data.description: A Texas mother of three found herself facing a heartbreaking question after her family’s finances unraveled. Her husband lost his job, they were in Chapter 13 bankruptcy, and most of their debt came from a failed Bitcoin mining business that...
